name: LEGO® Serious Play®
description: Facilitated workshop methodology using LEGO bricks for strategic planning, organizational development, and team-building. Originally developed by LEGO Group with MIT Media Lab. Methodology open since 2010 under Creative Commons; used worldwide for complex organizational sensemaking.
evaluation_method: facilitated debrief, narrative sharing, emergent shared understanding
general_score_metric: qualitative participant-reported outcomes (narrative debriefs), measures of shared understanding and engagement; no standardized numeric metric
notes: Methodology released under Creative Commons in 2010. Certified facilitators trained worldwide. Used in organizational development, strategy, and team-building contexts.
